summary_en: Mitsubishi Electric completed the acquisition of full ownership of PCI Energy Solutions on November 2, 2026. The U.S.-based software company, which develops and provides energy trading management and optimization solutions, reported revenues of 81,383 thousand USD for the year ended December 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Full Subsidiary Acquisition of U.S. PCI Energy Solutions
translation_en_brief:
Mitsubishi Electric Corporation announced the completion of acquiring full ownership of PCI Energy Solutions, a U.S.-based software company, effective November 2, 2026. The transaction was initially disclosed on August 20, 2026. PCI Energy Solutions, formally registered as Power Costs, Inc., is headquartered in Norman, Oklahoma and specializes in developing and providing software for energy trading management and optimization. The company was founded in 1992 and reported consecutive revenue growth over the past three years: 59.3 million USD in 2023, 67.8 million USD in 2024, and 81.4 million USD in 2025.

The acquisition represents Mitsubishi Electric's strategic expansion in the energy software solutions sector. The company will evaluate whether any revision to consolidated earnings forecasts or material announcements is necessary as a result of this transaction and will disclose such information promptly if required.
